_comment: Two-person control (maker-checker) for FETAN's loan committee.
This is the whole of FETAN's loan approval workflow requirement, implemented as
configuration. No custom backend module and no self-built Fineract image are
needed, because FETAN confirmed that 'Check' and 'Approve' are the same decision
made by two different people rather than three separate sign-offs.
2. A committee Maker approves it           (APPROVE_LOAN) → recorded as PENDING
3. A committee Checker confirms it         (CHECKER_SUPER_USER) → now APPROVED
4. Disbursement repeats the same two steps (DISBURSE_LOAN)
maker-checker             master switch — nothing is queued unless this is on
enable-same-maker-checker MUST stay false, or one person could check their own
work and two-person control would be defeated
_permissionsComment: Only these actions require a second person. Everything else Fineract ships as
maker-checkable is turned OFF by the seed step — see maker-checker.mjs.
